physics-e5-q4.title: Ụgbọ ala gafere ebe
physics-e5-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-e5-q4.material: Ụgbọ ala gafere ebe nlekọta ọsọ ọkara n'okporo ụzọ ukwu (ngụkọta 30 km) n'ime nkeji 15. Kedu ọsọ ọkara ụgbọ ala ahụ n'ime km n'ọtụtụ elekere?
physics-e5-q4.s.s1.prompt: Ụgbọ ala gafere ebe nlekọta ọsọ ọkara n'okporo ụzọ ukwu (ngụkọta 30 km) n'ime nkeji 15. Kedu ọsọ ọkara ụgbọ ala ahụ n'ime km n'ọtụtụ elekere?
physics-e5-q4.s.s1.explain: Nkeji $15$ bụ $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ elekere ($\frac{1}{4}$ elekere). Ọsọ ọkara bụ $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.

physics-e5-q4.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-killer-05.title: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-aga
physics-killer-05.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-05.material: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-aga n'ntụziaka $+x$ n'ọsọ $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ike n'ntụziaka $+x$ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe a; ịdị ukwuu ike na-abawanye nke nta nke nta site na $0$ ruo $40\,\mathrm{N}$ n'oge $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, na-anọgide na $40\,\mathrm{N}$ n'oge $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, ma na-ebelata nke nta nke nta site na $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ruo $0$ n'oge $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ịdị ukwuu impulse ihe nwetara n'ime $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ nke ike a rụrụ ọrụ, na ọsọ ihe ozugbo ike ahụ ga-apụ? (Enweghị ike ọzọ.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-aga n'ntụziaka $+x$ n'ọsọ $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ike n'ntụziaka $+x$ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe a; ịdị ukwuu ike na-abawanye nke nta nke nta site na $0$ ruo $40\,\mathrm{N}$ n'oge $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, na-anọgide na $40\,\mathrm{N}$ n'oge $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$, ma na-ebelata nke nta nke nta site na $40\,\mathrm{N}$ ruo $0$ n'oge $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ịdị ukwuu impulse ihe nwetara n'ime $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ nke ike a rụrụ ọrụ, na ọsọ ihe ozugbo ike ahụ ga-apụ? (Enweghị ike ọzọ.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Ebe: triangle mbụ $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, rectangle $0.2\cdot40=8$, triangle ikpeazụ $2$, yabụ $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. Site na $I=m(v-v_0)$, $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ọ bụrụ na e were eserese niile dị ka rectangle $40\cdot0.4=16$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ②; ọ bụrụ na e hapụ akụkụ triangle were $8$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ③; ọ bụrụ na e kewaghị $I$ site na ibu ma mee $4+12=16$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
physics-killer-05.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
